title: Box Cats Puzzle
description:
This Is A Puzzle Game.

You Need to Help the Cats Get into the Box.

★200 Challenging Levels

★casual Mode With Unlimited Fun

★You can make your own levels to share with friends

BGM:　Piano25 By MAOUDAMASHII

Our latest game mode - CatEX (Cat Express) Put the messy kittens into express boxes and pack them away

Free DLC-Cat Year 2022a small physics game. You need to stack multiple cats of different shapes on top of each other, so that you can pass the level by keeping them from falling for a certain period of time. 

★41 unstable levels 

BGM: 猫のワルツ By ゆうきわたる 

The new model of the year of the ox:Move other kittens so that our "CowCat" can eat grass 

★30 new levels 

BGM:Kurukuru By ONTAMA 

Our first DLC-Halloween modeThree cats of different shapes are randomly generated in each round. You need to put them in the box. If the cats are connected in a line, they will become bats and fly away until the box is full. How many cats can you put in？ 

BGM: Halloween night By Syappon
description_short: This is a puzzle game. A lot of cute cats want to enter a box, you need to help them~！
